'''Chapter 1119''' is titled "Emet". 

==Cover Page==
[[Oni Child Yamato's Golden Harvest Surrogate Pilgrimage]], Vol. 9: "Kibi — Pelted with rocks by children who hate Kaidou."

==Short Summary==
[[Kaku]] reluctantly allows for [[Stussy]] to escape. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] decides the only way to deal with the [[Five Elders]] is to knock them away from [[Egghead]]. Using teamwork his group knocks [[Marcus Mars|Mars]] away. [[Vegapunk/Atlas|Atlas]] decides to go check on the status of the [[Thousand Sunny]]. The video [[Den Den Mushi]] comes back online displaying more of the message, which [[Vegapunk/York|York]] explains to the Elders they have to destroy it completely. [[Shepherd Ju Peter|Ju Peter]] releases the [[Cipher Pol]] agents from his body to try to suck up the [[Giant Warrior Pirates]]' ship forcing Luffy to stop him just as [[Jewelry Bonney|Bonney]] runs out of energy and reverts to her child form. [[Emet]], the Iron Giant then stops [[Topman Warcury|Warcury]]'s attack, as it states to [[Joy Boy]] to remember him when the time is right.

==Long Summary==

Once free, [[Kaku]] tells [[Stussy]] to go, stating that while they may have been cold-blooded colleagues once, he claims they are not friends, and when [[Rob Lucci|Lucci]] arrives, he will not be able to stop him from killing her for her treachery. Stussy leaves with tears in her eyes, with Kaku fighting back his own.

On the coast, the [[Marines]] are shocked to see [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] now looks like his current wanted poster, while the [[Giants]] are dancing and singing. [[Marcus Mars|Mars]] calls Bonney's transformation an imitation of her [[Toshi Toshi no Mi|Devil Fruit powers]], so he is not intimidated. When he fires a blast of energy at the giants again, Luffy blocks it by making himself larger, even though he still feels pain. He tells his friends that the [[Five Elders]] cannot be hurt physically, so they need to knock him far away. He tells them to hit him in his large state as hard as they can, which [[Sanji]] and [[Franky]] agree, though Bonney was more concerned. The Giants move to extinguish the fire as Sanji, Franky, and Bonney unleash simultaneous attacks on Luffy's body, which also hurts him because most of them are using [[Haki]]. Luffy grabs Mars and pulls him into his inflated body just as the others' attacks hit him, and with their momentum, Luffy blasts Mars off into the sky with a new move called ''Gomu Gomu no Dawn Balloon''.

With Mars gone, the Giants resume setting sail, but the crew notice that [[Usopp|Usopp's]] group has not arrived yet, so [[Vegapunk/Atlas|Atlas]] decides to check it out, only to be informed that [[Vegapunk/York|York]] is monitoring both her and [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith's]] positions. Meanwhile, the Iron Giant lands on the ocean floor as [[Vegapunk|Dr. Vegapunk's]] broadcast resumes, where he continues talking about the meaning of the secret name [[Will of D.|D]]. York informs the Elders that they only caused a temporary interruption when they attacked the Iron Giant. Therefore, the only way to stop the broadcast permanently is to destroy the [[Den Den Mushi|Broadcast Den Den Mushi]] within the Iron Giant itself.

Luffy and the others notice something falling from the sky, which turns out to be a bunch of rubble mixed with the captive [[Cipher Pol]] agents swallowed by [[Shepherd Ju Peter|Ju Peter]], which he started firing out of his mouth at the pirates. The Marines start catching the falling agents and [[Seraphim]] as Ju Peter starts sucking in the Giants' ship. The Giants decide to use the oars while Luffy punches Ju Peter to get him to stop. While he is busy fighting, [[Topman Warcury|Warcury]] charges forward, jumping off the coast to ram into and destroy the ship. As for Bonney, she turns back to normal, as she ran out of energy to maintain her form.

However, before Warcury can make contact, the Iron Giant, whose name is revealed to be [[Emet]], emerges from the ocean and punches Warcury, breaking one of his tusks. Its return shocks everyone, especially Luffy.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Kaku]] tells [[Stussy]] to escape.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], [[Jewelry Bonney|Bonney]], [[Sanji]], and [[Franky]] manage to launch [[Marcus Mars|Mars]] away from [[Egghead]] with a combined attack.
**Bonney is shown using [[Haki/Armament Haki|Armament Haki]]. 
*[[Vegapunk/Atlas|Atlas]] heads to the Labophase to check on the [[Thousand Sunny]] group.
*[[Vegapunk/York|York]] tells the [[Five Elders]] that [[Vegapunk]]'s transmission can only be truly interrupted by destroying the Broadcast Den Den Mushi inside the Iron Giant.
*[[Shepherd Ju Peter|Ju Peter]] spits out the captive [[Cipher Pol]] agents and [[Seraphim]] he inhaled earlier onto the [[Marines|Marine]] ships.
**Ju Peter attempts to suck in the [[Giant Warrior Pirates]]' ship, but Luffy stops him.
*The Iron Giant's name is revealed: [[Emet]].
**Emet stops [[Topman Warcury|Warcury]] from destroying the Giant Pirates' ship.
**Emet recalls a past conversation with [[Joy Boy]] regarding its purpose.
